environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with direct PostgreSQL RDS connection (no connection pooler). Service exposed via AWS ALB with default configuration. Single-AZ deployment with predictable network latency. No rate limiting configured. Container runs with default Node.js event loop with no additional jitter. Health checks on /health only.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 RDS, direct connection, same AZ
config.network: ALB -> ECS service, single AZ, no CloudFront
